entities.summary: Femke Stoltenborg is a Dutch volleyball player, who plays as a setter. She is a member of the Netherlands Women's National Team. She participated at the 2010 FIVB Volleyball World Grand Prix, and 2017 FIVB Volleyball World Grand Prix.
